topPRs.title: test(#12375): launcher gesture long-loop web lanes + real-browser CdpTouchDriver fixes
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
Closes the remaining web-lane work for #12375 (#12179 WI-6). The #12373 loop
engine + native/desktop/matrix lanes are already merged; this lands the two
web lanes and fixes the engine's real-browser driver gaps that only a live run
could surface.

## What this adds

- **Fixture web lane** — `packages/ui/src/components/shell/__e2e__/run-launcher-loop-e2e.mjs` (`test:launcher-loop-e2e`). esbuild-bundles the REAL composed home↔launcher fixture, runs `runLauncherLoop` in fresh `hasTouch` contexts, **500 CDP-touch actions in 5 batches of 100**, video + trace on, a blue/hover brand scan bookending the run. Only a failing batch keeps its (video, trace, seed, shrunk path); the final passing batch's video is the walkthrough.
- **Real-app lane** — `packages/app/test/ui-smoke/launcher-gesture-loop.spec.ts` drives the same engine against the **booted app's** composed surface via public test ids (`home-launcher-surface`/`-page-probe`/…), navigation-safe alphabet (`tileIds: []`), on desktop `chromium` + `mobile-chromium`. Runs in CI via `scenario-pr.yml`'s Pixel-7 lane (added to the `mobile-chromium` testMatch).
- **Engine real-browser fixes** (`packages/ui/src/testing/launcher-loop/cdp-gestures.ts`) — the blocker the #12179 reconciliation flagged: committing rail swipes were dropped at `stepDelayMs: 2` (now 16ms/step + bounded re-dispatch reading `data-page`); the driver/`observe()` notification-open selectors missed `notification-sheet[data-open]`; `settle()` returned mid-commit (now waits for animations done + rail parked); `tapTile` tapped off-window tiles after a scroll (now scrolls into view first).
- **CI** — `chat-shell-gestures.yml` runs the fixture loop (pinned seed 12375) and uploads `output-launcher-loop`.
- **Docs** — `LAUNCHER_INTERACTION_MATRIX.md`: `loop-web`/`loop-web-app` promoted pending→live; Status documents the fixes, the two scoped-out families, and the failure-replay flow.

## Evidence

- **3 consecutive full seeds green locally** at 500 actions: `12375`, `424242`, `387289096` (the last two are the historically-failing seeds from the #12179 evidence run). Additional smoke seeds `1`, `3`, `7` also green.
- Committed artifacts: `output-launcher-loop/launcher-loop.webm` (500-action walkthrough), `brand-scan.json` (0 blue before/after), `launcher-loop.html`.
- Engine jsdom self-check `launcher-loop.test.ts`: **9/9 pass** with the driver changes. Biome clean; `packages/ui` typecheck clean for the touched files.

## Scoped out of the touch loop (not untested)

- `railEdgeButton` — chevrons self-hide on coarse pointer, but the model always navigates. Covered by the desktop `launcher-interaction` spec.
- `tileLongPress` — the read-only launcher tile is a plain `onClick` button (no long-press affordance), so a stationary touch long-press launches on release while the model treats it as inert. Tap-vs-long-press is covered on the real app by `gesture-matrix`.

## Honest caveat

The **real-app ui-smoke lane could not be executed in this git-worktree** (the app renderer build needs per-package `node_modules` — `@types/node` typeRoots, `lucide-react`, `@capacitor/*` — that only a full `bun install` provides). The spec is authored, wired, and import/type-verified; it executes in CI (`scenario-pr.yml`) and any full checkout. The **fixture lane fully proves the engine + CdpTouchDriver in a real browser** against the same composed surface bundle.

## Replay

Failing batch → `failure-batch-<n>.json` (run seed, batch seed, fast-check shrunk command list). Rerun `ELIZA_LOOP_SEED=<seed>` to reproduce, or `ELIZA_LOOP_ONLY_BATCH=<n>` for just that batch.

topPRs.title: fix(#12371): drop last home-launcher event-bridge remnants (page-only shell store)
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## What & why

Issue #12371 (WI-1 of #12179) asked for a page-only shell-surface store, deletion of the `eliza:home-launcher:navigate` window-event bridge, removal of `useShellController.navigateToViews` + fixture stubs, and a clean `HomeLauncherSurface` (no `className` / `launcherPage` reads / `launcherPageCount` writes / dead rail-button gating).

**The bulk of that already landed on `develop` in #12290** ("#12179 Phase 1"): `packages/ui/src/state/shell-surface-store.ts` is already page-only (`{ page }` only), `home-launcher-events.ts` is deleted, `useShellController` has no `navigateToViews`, and `HomeLauncherSurface.tsx` has no `className` prop, no `launcherPage`/`launcherPageCount`, and live (`canPrev`/`canNext`) edge-button gating.

This PR clears the **two remaining loose ends** that still tripped the issue's acceptance greps and left dead code paths:

1. **Three `packages/app/test/ui-smoke` helpers still dispatched the deleted `eliza:home-launcher:navigate` CustomEvent** as a deterministic nav shortcut. With the bridge gone nothing listens, so their `data-page=launcher` assertions would time out. Replaced each with a **real leftward drag across `home-launcher-home-page`** using the shared `mousePointerDrag` helper — the same rail gesture the UI uses, which calls the store action `goLauncher()` directly (matching the "call store actions directly" requirement).
   - `assistant-home-flow.spec.ts` (`openHomeLauncher`)
   - `gesture-matrix.spec.ts` (`openLauncherHalf`)
   - `home-widget-priority.spec.ts` (launcher capture)

2. **Two committed e2e HTML bundles were stale** esbuild output baked from pre-#12290 source, still containing `home-launcher-events`, `launcherPage`, `launcherPageCount`, and a fixture `navigateToViews` stub. Regenerated `chat-sheet.html` and `warmup-eviction.html` from current source using the runners' own esbuild config — legacy strings gone.

## Done-when checklist

- [x] Grep for `home-launcher-events`, `dispatchHomeLauncherNavigation`, `launcherPageCount` returns **no hits** anywhere in `packages/`.
- [x] `navigateToViews` remains only as the **unrelated `ViewStatusStates` `/views` router-nav** (explicitly exempted by the issue).
- [x] `launcherPage` remains only as **local test variables** naming the unchanged `home-launcher-launcher-page` data-page testid (the data-page contract must stay).
- [x] Home ↔ launcher navigation still works via direct store actions (real rail gesture → `goLauncher()`/`goHome()`).
- [x] iOS AX probe (`home-launcher-page-probe`) and `data-page` contracts unchanged.

## Verification

- `bun run --cwd packages/ui test -- shell-surface-store HomeLauncherSurface useShellController` → **5 files / 90 tests passed**.
- `bun run --cwd packages/ui typecheck` → only the **pre-existing, unrelated** `iwer` module error in `spatial/__e2e__/immersive-fixture.ts` (present identically on `develop`; untouched here).
- Biome lint on the 3 edited specs → clean.
- `packages/app` full typecheck / Playwright e2e need built `@elizaos/*` dists + a browser (impractical in this shared-node_modules worktree) — **relying on CI**. My spec edits call the existing `mousePointerDrag(page, Locator, dx, dy, { steps })` with a matching signature; an isolated tsc pass on the edited spec surfaced no new errors.

Closes #12371
